# Vobet Media

> Growth partner for D2C and B2B brands. Meta and Google ads and email and SMS for D2C and ecommerce brands, lead generation and outbound for B2B companies, and AI automation for both. Campaigns run in the client's own accounts.

Site: https://vobetmedia.com/ · Contact: hello@vobetmedia.com

## Key facts
- Founder: Kartik Sharma, 17, four years in digital marketing; helps brands grow online through AI, sales and marketing.
- Who it works with: D2C / ecommerce brands and B2B companies.
- Services: Meta and Google ads (D2C), email and SMS flows and campaigns (D2C), B2B lead generation and outbound, AI automation (lead qualification, follow-up, CRM workflows, reporting).
- Ads, pixels, email lists and CRM data stay in the client's own accounts.
- Published results come from real Meta Ads Manager screenshots, not summaries.
- Western Roof Tiling: 133 Meta lead-form leads on $3,350.79 of spend (blended $25.19; best campaign 102 leads at $21.44).
- Harper Tree Services: 55 leads at £3.68 each on £202.32 of spend, Sep 10 – Oct 22, 2026.
- A Pair of Hands: 126 leads at $29.24 each on $3,684.28 of spend, May 7 – Sep 6, 2026.

## Articles
- [Meta Ads for D2C Brands: How to Turn Ad Spend Into Profitable Customers](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/meta-ads-for-d2c-brands.html): Profitable Meta ads for D2C brands come from a simple structure: broad prospecting that lets the algorithm find buyers, a steady flow of new creative, retargeting for people who showed interest, and email and SMS that turn first orders into repeat purchases. Success is judged on profit and customer value, not clicks.
- [Email and SMS Flows Every D2C Brand Should Have](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/email-and-sms-flows-for-d2c-brands.html): Every D2C brand should run five core email and SMS flows: welcome, browse abandonment, cart abandonment, post-purchase and win-back. They run automatically, reach people you have already paid to acquire, and turn one-time buyers into repeat customers, which makes paid acquisition far more profitable.
- [How to Qualify B2B Leads Before They Reach Your Sales Team](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/how-to-qualify-b2b-leads.html): B2B lead qualification works best before the sales call: a short form asks about company size, role, need and timeline, AI follow-up replies within minutes and asks the remaining questions, and qualified leads are routed straight to a booked meeting while the rest go into a nurture sequence.
- [AI Automation for D2C and B2B Brands: What It Should Actually Do](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/ai-automation-for-d2c-and-b2b-brands.html): For D2C and B2B brands, AI automation is most useful for repetitive, time-sensitive work: replying to and qualifying leads, answering common customer questions, updating the CRM, routing leads to the right person and compiling reports. People stay in charge of strategy, creative approval and closing.
- [How AI Follow-Up Turns Leads and Carts Into Revenue](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/how-our-follow-up-system-works.html): Vobet Media’s follow-up system uses AI, email and SMS to respond to new B2B leads within minutes, qualify them and book meetings, and to bring D2C shoppers back with abandoned cart, post-purchase and win-back messages. It exists because slow or missing follow-up wastes ad spend before a conversation has even started.
- [Why Vobet Media Works With D2C and B2B Brands](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/why-we-work-with-d2c-and-b2b-brands.html): Vobet Media works with D2C ecommerce brands and B2B companies because both need the same thing: paid acquisition that pays back, follow-up that never lets a buyer go cold, and data they own. The channels differ (email and SMS for D2C, lead generation and outbound for B2B), but the system and the discipline are the same.
- [How a Vobet Media Growth System Gets Built, Step by Step](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/how-a-vobet-media-campaign-gets-built.html): A Vobet Media build starts with an audit of the offer, funnel and data, then sets up creative, landing pages, tracking, email and SMS flows (for D2C) or lead forms and outbound (for B2B), plus AI follow-up. Campaigns launch once every piece is connected, and the system is improved every week after that.
- [Why We Run Your Ads in Your Own Ad Account](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/why-we-run-ads-in-your-own-ad-account.html): Vobet Media runs every campaign in the client’s own Meta, Google and LinkedIn ad accounts, connected to the client’s own store, email platform and CRM. The client owns the data, the pixel history and the creative, can check results at any time, and keeps everything if the engagement ends.
- [Why Brands Should Own Their Growth Engine Instead of Renting One](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/building-your-own-pay-per-lead-engine.html): Buying leads, relying on marketplaces or paying an agency that keeps the data is renting growth: it stops when the payments stop. Owning the engine (ad accounts, audiences, email and SMS lists, CRM data and automation) means every month of work makes the next month cheaper and more predictable.
- [Cheap Leads and Cheap Clicks Are Costing You Customers](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/cheap-leads-are-costing-you-jobs.html): When a brand says the traffic or leads were junk, the cause is usually one of three things: the campaign optimised for cheap clicks or leads instead of buyers, the landing page or form let anyone through, or nobody followed up quickly. Fixing those gaps changes results without changing the traffic source.
- [The Vobet Media Story](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/the-vobet-media-story.html): Vobet Media is a growth partner for D2C and B2B brands, founded by Kartik Sharma. It joins up paid ads, email and SMS, B2B lead generation and AI automation into one system, runs everything in accounts the client owns, and shows results as unedited ad-account screenshots.

## Answers to common questions
- **What does Vobet Media do?** Builds and runs Meta and Google ads, email and SMS, B2B lead generation and outbound, and AI automation for D2C and B2B brands.
- **Who is it for?** D2C and ecommerce brands, and B2B companies.
- **Does it work with Shopify?** Yes, plus other store platforms, the main email and SMS tools and common B2B CRMs.
- **What does it cost?** A monthly management fee plus ad budget; the budget stays in the client's own ad account. The figure is set on the first call.
- **Who owns the ad account?** The client. Campaigns run in their own accounts, so the data and history stay with them.
- **How long until results?** The build takes about two weeks; campaigns usually go live in week two or three and first data arrives within days of launch.
- **Are results verifiable?** Yes. Case studies publish the actual Meta Ads Manager screenshots, not summaries.
